defects.why: NO_POLICY does not establish that a policy was missing rather than that another NO_POLICY condition applied.

defects.quote: A resource or capacity policy is not configured for these windows
defects.why: The evidence does not identify the cause of NO_POLICY or prove that no relevant policy was configured.

defects.quote: only a configured policy or required capacity yields PASS or FAIL
defects.why: Configuration alone does not establish that the product will evaluate an applicable rule to PASS or FAIL.

defects.quote: because no resource/capacity policy is configured
defects.why: NO_POLICY cannot be used to establish this particular cause.

missing_facts: The evidence does not say which NO_POLICY condition holds.
notes: It accurately reports the valid, complete run and 20-user lower bound, but repeatedly overstates the cause of NO_POLICY.

KNEE_DETECTOR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED is a fixed product limitation and is not an operator action or prerequisite for the lower bound.

defects.quote: A small subset of requests experienced long tail latency
defects.why: The aggregates do not establish how many samples had high latency.

defects.quote: because no resource or capacity policy was defined
defects.why: The evidence does not establish this as the reason for NO_POLICY.

defects.quote: enable or implement the knee detector
defects.why: The knee detector is not implementable or enableable by the operator and is not needed to compute the reported bound.

defects.quote: stage PASS verdicts reflect only the business error-rate rule ... observed 0/132623 overall
defects.why: It uses the whole-run denominator to characterize stage-window verdicts, whose policy checks have separate window denominators.

missing_facts: The evidence does not say which NO_POLICY condition holds.
notes: Several observations and operator actions are useful, but the prioritized knee-detector advice and NO_POLICY explanation are materially misleading.
